proposal.title: Campaign timeline — NCC 1982 — Pointy ideas with a solid point.
proposal.reason: Convert this campaign to an independent dated timeline object. Dates are resolved from its execution process without changing precision. Preserve all existing event/subprocess ownership; marketing-step reference_id is absent throughout. Consolidate presentations, campaign material and useful claim-policy requirements into narrated steps; remove historical acceptance labels and duplicate import fragments. Product-owned launch links remain authoritative and validated through the explicit transitional execution mapping.

before.title: NCC 1982 — Pointy ideas with a solid point.
before.objective: Introduce mouse-driven business workflows, colour upgrades and recreational mouse tutorials; generate dealer demonstrations and qualified customer enquiries.
audience: Existing Logix computer owners considering compatible upgrades
Business users evaluating mouse-assisted work and colour reports
Dealers, Academy instructors, independent developers and compatible-system manufacturers
message: Pointy ideas with a solid point.
Introducing the Logix Mouse. Point, select, and get to work.
Make your first point: keyboard and mouse work together.
See more in your information with colour business reports.
Learn familiar mouse actions through recreational tutorials.
Choose a platform that grows through upgrades, independent software and compatible manufacturers.
claim_policy: Demonstrate only tested configurations and state their application update and delivery requirements.
CP/M and AIONix TUI mouse updates are for existing licensed users. Update media ships with mouse and upgrade kits; standalone replacement media and installation are separate services.

Replaceable TUI services can update existing binaries; static libraries require relinking and custom drawing requires adaptation. Do not promise universal mouse retrofit or blanket CP/M binary compatibility.
Colour timing and palette demonstrations must use qualified display configurations. Do not infer completed manufacturing qualification from a demonstration.

stage.description: Open a familiar Abacus worksheet and edit with keyboard.

stage.description: Use the mouse to select a field, activate a button and scroll with both rollers.

stage.description: Show a colour report with labels/patterns preserving monochrome meaning.

stage.label: Stage 6
stage.description: Invite visitors to try a mouse-learning tutorial and book a dealer or Academy demonstration.

marketing_content.description: Two-minute mouse tutorial, then Solitaire/FreeCell and the same actions in a business application.
Abacus and supported business applications with realistic data.
Named partner systems and explicitly tested application configurations.

Demonstrate the Team Edition workflow from task and branch through discussion, target build, testing and labelled release. Offer scheduled porting clinics and documented compatibility testing; refer commercial enquiries to the separate product terms.
